description: This PHP script manages the assignment of test case versions to multiple test plans within the TestLink testing management system. It initializes page components, retrieves test case and test plan data, manages linking logic between test case versions and test plans, and prepares data for rendering the user interface.

methods.name: init_args
methods.description: Creates a namespace object with request and session parameters for test plan and project IDs, test case ID, and test case version ID.

methods.name: initializeGui
methods.description: Initializes the GUI object with page title, test case identity, description, and cancel action JavaScript, based on provided arguments.
